🎯 5-Tier 0s/1s/2s Matchup Thresholds (SW, W, N, L, SL)

• SW = Strong Win (rating >= 620) (Default: 620)
• W = Win (530 <= rating < 620) (Default: 530)
• N = Neutral / Grey (470 < rating < 530) (Default: 470–530)
• L = Loss (380 < rating <= 470) (Default: 470)
• SL = Strong Loss (rating <= 380) (Default: 380)

Control the overlay directly from Tasker without entering the app, or launch straight to the Battle Log page:
• Package: com.gbl.overlay
• Start Overlay (Target: Activity or Broadcast Receiver):
 Action: com.gbl.overlay.ACTION_START_OVERLAY (or com.gbl.overlay.START)
 Optional Extra: team:<Team Name>
• Stop Overlay (Target: Broadcast Receiver, Service, or Activity):
 Action: com.gbl.overlay.ACTION_STOP_OVERLAY (or com.gbl.overlay.STOP)
• Open Battle Log Page (Target: Activity or Launch App → SilphScope Battle Log):
 Action: com.gbl.overlay.ACTION_OPEN_BATTLE_LOG (or Extra page:battle_log)
